defs.label: Raised by
defs.desc: Who is raising this. Sets the tone of the update and who receives it.

defs.label: How this reached us
defs.desc: How the report reached the desk.

defs.label: Reporter name
defs.desc: Full name of the person who raised it, as they want to be addressed.

defs.label: Reporter email or phone
defs.desc: Best number or email for a call-back.

defs.label: Preferred contact channel
defs.desc: Where the first update should go.

defs.label: Where the member wants the answer
defs.desc: If the follow-up should go somewhere else.

defs.label: Studio
defs.desc: Where it happened. Drives the room list, the owner and Momence lookups.

defs.label: Area / room
defs.desc: The room or spot, if it matters.
defs.condText: Yes — after Studio

defs.label: Date & time of occurrence
defs.desc: When it actually happened, not when it was typed.

defs.label: How recent?
defs.desc: Quick answer when the exact time is unclear.

defs.label: Class format
defs.desc: Which class or offering this is about.
defs.condText: Yes — if a class is involved

defs.label: Class date & slot
defs.desc: Pick the session so the roll and coach come with it.
defs.condText: Yes — if class-related

defs.label: Trainer on session
defs.desc: Who was coaching.
defs.condText: Yes — if class or trainer involved

defs.label: Members affected (count)
defs.desc: How many members were affected. Leave blank if none.
defs.condText: Yes — if more than one member

defs.label: Is this a repeat of a previous issue?
defs.desc: Has this come up before? A linked ticket jumps the queue.

defs.label: Related ticket ID
defs.desc: The earlier ticket, if one is already open.
defs.condText: Yes — if is_repeat = 'Yes, ticket already open'

defs.label: Impact on member
defs.desc: How much this affected the member or the floor. Sets the priority floor.

defs.label: Did it block or degrade a class?
defs.desc: Whether a live class is affected — blocking now outranks everything else.
defs.condText: Yes — if class_format or class_date is filled

defs.label: Immediate danger to anyone?
defs.desc: Any "yes" makes this critical and pages the manager on duty.

defs.label: Ticket title
defs.desc: One line, drafted from the sub-category and studio — edit freely.

defs.label: What happened (summary)
defs.desc: Two to four sentences in the reporter’s own words. At least 12 characters.

defs.label: Requested resolution
defs.desc: What the reporter wants to walk away with.

defs.label: Member sentiment
defs.desc: How the member came across.
defs.condText: Yes — if reporter_type = Member/Prospect

defs.label: Churn risk
defs.desc: Your read on whether they might not renew.
defs.condText: Yes — if sentiment = Frustrated/Negative

defs.label: Requested day / time / format
defs.desc: e.g. 'Barre 57 Advanced, Tue 7:00am at Kwality House'.
defs.condText: Yes — for add or move requests

defs.label: Schedule change requested
defs.desc: The specific edit being asked for. Keeps schedule requests from arriving as prose.

defs.label: Duration of change
defs.desc: Whether this is a one-off or a standing change to the published timetable.
defs.condText: Yes — if schedule_action is filled

defs.label: Current / affected slot
defs.desc: Existing session the request is against.
defs.condText: Yes — for change or remove requests

defs.label: Demand evidence
defs.desc: Who asked, how many, waitlist count. Needed to defend the slot in planning.
defs.condText: Yes — for 'Add a new slot'

defs.label: Summary of what each attendee said
What the desk did in the room
Put it in the review cycle
Method deviation?
defs.desc: Whether what happened is outside the Physique 57 method as trained, which changes it from a preference into a coaching/re-certification item.
defs.condText: Yes — if feedback is about the class itself

defs.label: Alternate trainer(s) available
defs.desc: Named alternates from the roster, so the substitution is decided in one pass, not debated on a call.
defs.condText: Yes — if a swap, cover or leave is being requested

defs.label: Impact on published grid
defs.desc: Whether members already see the slot, which changes how it must be communicated.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Affected members notified?
defs.desc: Publishing a change without notifying bookings is what produces the next 10 tickets.
defs.condText: Yes — if grid changes

defs.label: Effective date
defs.desc: When the new standard starts being audited against.
defs.condText: Yes — if the SOP is changing

defs.label: Policy owner to approve
defs.desc: Every SOP change needs a named approver before it is published.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Manual entry process running?
defs.desc: Members must not be turned away while the device is down.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: What went wrong
defs.desc: Pick all that apply; feeds the trainer's coaching conversation rather than a vague complaint.

defs.label: Fixed before ticket filed?
defs.desc: If yes, the ticket becomes a process issue, not an outage, and the SLA is relaxed deliberately.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Did anyone get hurt or nearly?
Where in the class
defs.desc: Which block the issue landed in - pinpoints whether it is choreography, pacing or floor behaviour.

defs.label: Housekeeping log reference
defs.desc: Shift entry showing when the area was last cleaned. Distinguishes a lapse from a missing schedule.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Member's exact words
defs.desc: Quotation, unedited. The key member statements are what actually settle disputes.
defs.condText: Yes — if a member raised it

defs.label: Source & console
defs.desc: Which input the class was running off, needed before anything is changed on the playlist.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Requested music action
defs.desc: Turns ambience feedback into a single, schedulable edit for the heads.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Measured reading now
defs.desc: Therometer/manometer value at filing. Turns a comfort complaint into a defensible record.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Vendor/platform ticket raised
defs.desc: Momence / Stripe / Yellow / ISP reference. Keeps us from carrying a third party's clock silently.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Written statement collected?
defs.desc: Statements are collected before parties are separated, or the account diverges permanently.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Already coached on this?
defs.desc: Prevents a first-instance conduct issue skipping straight to escalation.
defs.condText: Yes — if conduct or performance

defs.label: Nature of feedback
defs.desc: Routes between coaching (heads) and conduct (HR-visible) handling.

defs.label: Trainer concerned
defs.desc: The trainer this feedback is about - not necessarily the reporter.

defs.label: Reporting line concern
defs.desc: If the subject is Mrigakshi / Vivaran / Pushyank, the ticket must go to Anisha directly.
defs.condText: Yes — if trainer is a Head Trainer

defs.label: Member involved (name + ID)
defs.desc: Needed to check the class roster and, if conduct-related, to get a statement.
defs.condText: Yes — if feedback involves a specific client

defs.label: Asset ID / unit number
defs.desc: e.g. BIKE-07, LOCKER-B12, AC-KW-01. Ties the ticket to the equipment register row (assetId).
defs.condText: Yes — for countable or numbered units

defs.label: Expected / actual downtime
defs.desc: Lets ops plan class substitutions around the outage window.
defs.condText: Yes — if usable is not 'Yes, fully'

defs.label: Still usable?
defs.desc: 'No' must be answered before the next class - it decides whether a take-out-of-rotation notice goes out.

defs.label: Covered by AMC / vendor?
defs.desc: Decides whether Zahur fixes it in-house or raises a warranty call - the single biggest SLA lever here.

defs.label: Vendor visit logged?
defs.desc: No visit should be treated as done unless the eng-site entry exists - the historic log shows AMCs closing calls that never happened.
defs.condText: Yes — if a vendor or AMC is engaged

defs.label: Engineering site reference
defs.desc: The portal link where the vendor logged the call. Needed for AMC audit and billing.
defs.condText: Yes — if vendor_amc starts with 'Yes'

defs.label: Quote / invoice reference
defs.desc: Cost reference for Accounts to approve.
defs.condText: Yes — if outside AMC coverage

defs.label: Vendor / AMC contractor
defs.condText: Yes — if vendor_amc starts with 'Yes'

defs.label: Circuit / fitting ID
defs.desc: Lets the electrician come once with the right part.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Water supply isolated?
defs.desc: First containment step; also the answer the landlord will ask for.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: SKU / product
defs.desc: Product code or name, with size, so retail stock can be moved without a phone call.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Stock on hand vs required
defs.desc: Count at the shelf now and what it should be.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Effective date
defs.desc: When the new standard starts being audited against.
defs.condText: Yes — if the SOP is changing

defs.label: SOP action required
defs.desc: What to do with the standard, not the asset.
defs.condText: Yes — if sub category mentions SOP

defs.label: SOP / checklist reference
defs.desc: SOP number or checklist item. Decides whether we are fixing a device or a written standard.
defs.condText: Yes — if the ticket is about an SOP itself

defs.label: Bike symptom (PowerCycle)
defs.desc: Straight from the Stages SC3 playbook so the fix and torque spec travel with the ticket.
defs.condText: Yes — if asset_type = PowerCycle bike

defs.label: Affected part
defs.desc: Stages SC3 parts list; drives which tools the technician brings.
defs.condText: Yes — if cycle_symptom is set

defs.label: Amenity / fixture
defs.desc: The thing being complained about or asked for.

defs.label: Time noticed (day part)
defs.desc: Peak vs off-peak decides whether we can act before the next class.

defs.label: Studio temperature (degC)
defs.desc: Read off the wall thermostat at filing. Studio temperature is the largest single facility bucket in the historic log, and a number kills 'it felt hot'.
defs.condText: Yes — if amenity is Air conditioning or Ventilation

defs.label: Valet / parking token
defs.desc: Token number - the only way a vehicle is traceable.
defs.condText: Yes — if amenity = Valet / parking

defs.label: Vendor visit needed?
defs.desc: Escalates a housekeeping item into a procurement action.

defs.label: Guests / walk-ins affected
defs.desc: Amenity faults at a partner venue (Courtside, Copper and Cloves) need the host's copy on the thread.
defs.condText: Yes — if it affects a class or event in progress

defs.label: Par level for that item
defs.desc: Target stock, to show whether par is wrong or replenishment is late.
defs.condText: Yes — if supply_count is filled

defs.label: Units short (count)
defs.desc: How short against par level.
defs.condText: Yes — for consumables, towels or toiletries

defs.label: Suspected time window
defs.desc: Narrowest window for CCTV review; wide windows are why footage searches fail.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Current entitlement on account
defs.desc: Read from Momence at filing so the reply is correct on the first contact.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Needs backdating / data correction?
defs.desc: Corrections must be logged for audit - this field creates the audit row.

defs.label: Is member or payment data affected?
defs.desc: 'Yes' pulls Accounts into the thread immediately and freezes bulk action until root cause is known.

defs.label: Device / terminal ID
defs.desc: e.g. iPad-FRONT-01, POS-BANDRA-02. Separates one bad terminal from a platform outage.
defs.condText: Yes — if system is not 'Other system'

defs.label: Failure mode
defs.desc: Distinguishes a hard outage from degraded data - the 'Momence does not give accurate data' problem in the historic log lives here.

defs.label: Scope
defs.desc: Studio-only faults are Zahur's; all-studio faults are a same-day vendor/platform escalation.

defs.label: Workaround in use
defs.desc: What the desk is doing meanwhile. Historic note: 'regularly sharing data manually' is itself the risk.
defs.condText: Yes — if failure_mode is not 'Cosmetic bug'

defs.label: Acceptable change window
defs.desc: Avoids patching a studio mid-timetable.
defs.condText: Yes — if a fix or migration is needed

defs.label: Error message / screenshot text
defs.desc: Copy the exact error string; it is what Milind pastes into the vendor ticket.
defs.condText: Yes — if failure_mode is an outage or error

defs.label: Affected Momence record ID
defs.desc: Session / appointment / member ID so the fix can be verified against the record.
defs.condText: Yes — if system = Momence

defs.label: Amount involved (INR)
defs.desc: Value in dispute, rupees.
defs.condText: Yes — if money is wrong or missing

defs.label: Device / serial
defs.desc: Serial or asset tag. Ties to warranty status in the equipment register.
defs.condText: Yes — if it is a physical device

defs.label: How often does it happen?
defs.desc: Intermittent faults need logging, not a restart; this sets that expectation.

defs.label: Member ID (Momence)
defs.condText: Yes — if user_type involves a member

defs.label: Steps to reproduce
defs.desc: What was done, what happened, what was expected. Cuts a round trip to IT.
defs.condText: Yes — if the fault is repeatable

defs.label: Transaction / payment reference
defs.desc: Gateway reference or last 4 digits. Accounts cannot reconcile without it.
defs.condText: Yes — if payment gateway or charges are involved

defs.label: Who is blocked
defs.desc: Member-facing outages outrank staff-facing faults on the same platform.

defs.label: Tax basis of the amount
defs.desc: The rates page prices in '++', so state the tax basis explicitly.
defs.condText: Yes — if amount_inr is filled

defs.label: Network / Wi-Fi status
defs.desc: Separates a studio network fault from a platform outage.
defs.condText: Yes — if streaming, Wi-Fi or app slowness

defs.label: Last restart / fix attempted
defs.desc: What the studio already tried, so IT does not start from zero.

defs.label: Account / login affected
defs.desc: Email or user ID for password and access resets.
defs.condText: Yes — if it is a login or access issue

defs.label: Membership / package held
defs.condText: Yes — if the request changes access or credits

defs.label: Receipt / invoice needed?
defs.desc: Digital receipts are a recurring request in the historic log.
defs.condText: Yes — if billing related

defs.label: Vendor / platform ticket raised
defs.desc: Momence / Stripe / Yellow / ISP reference. Stops us silently carrying someone else's clock.
defs.condText: Yes — if the fault sits with a third party

defs.label: Action Accounts must take
defs.desc: One field that makes a finance ticket actionable on arrival.
defs.condText: Yes — for this sub category

defs.label: Amount actually charged (INR)
defs.desc: Actual billed value from the statement.
defs.condText: Yes — if a charge is disputed

defs.label: Classes / days remaining
defs.desc: Count at the moment of filing, so the correction is checkable.
defs.condText: Yes — if expiry or credit is disputed

defs.label: Rate card applying
defs.desc: Mumbai and Bengaluru carry different published prices, so the city decides who is right.
defs.condText: Yes — if pricing is disputed

defs.label: Reason for dispute
defs.desc: Structured root cause; feeds the accounts reconciliation queue.
defs.condText: Yes — if amount_expected or amount_charged is filled

defs.label: Current entitlement on account
defs.desc: Read from Momence at filing so the first reply is already correct.

defs.label: Freeze from / to
defs.desc: Requested window and the return date promised to the member.
defs.condText: Yes — if freeze_type is set

defs.label: GST / invoice impact
defs.desc: A refund on an invoiced sale means a credit note, not a wallet push.
defs.condText: Yes — if a refund is being issued

defs.label: Member email
defs.desc: On-account email; used to verify identity before any credit or refund.

defs.label: Member name
defs.desc: As it appears on the Momence account.

defs.label: Membership / package
defs.desc: Removes 'which of my three packs' ambiguity.

defs.label: Payment mode
defs.desc: Refund path differs by rail, which changes the resolution SLA.
defs.condText: Yes — if a payment is disputed

defs.label: Refund / credit amount (INR)
defs.desc: Value being given back.
defs.condText: Yes — if refund_required is not 'No'

defs.label: Refund / credit required?
defs.desc: Credits can go out same day; refunds need Sachin's approval and take longer - the SLA follows this field.

defs.label: Transaction / UPI reference
defs.desc: Gateway or bank reference for reconciliation.
defs.condText: Yes — if a payment is disputed

defs.label: Amount member expected (INR)
defs.desc: The figure the member believes applies, quoted from where they saw it.
defs.condText: Yes — if a charge is disputed

defs.label: Approval reference (Sachin / Mitali)
defs.desc: Approver plus date. Above Rs 25,000 nothing moves without it.
defs.condText: Yes — if refund_amount exceeds 25000

defs.label: Freeze / pause request
defs.desc: Freeze volume in the historic log makes this its own picker.
defs.condText: Yes — if this is a pause or lapse

defs.label: Payment date
defs.desc: Date of the debit, to locate the ledger entry.
defs.condText: Yes — if a payment is disputed

defs.label: Nature of the complaint
defs.desc: Sets whether the desk can close this or must hand it to another department.

defs.label: Desk owner assigned
defs.desc: Kemps/Courtside and Bandra run separate desks - pick the one that owns this member.

defs.label: Goodwill offered by desk
defs.desc: Approval boundary is explicit: the desk may credit up to one class without asking anyone.

defs.label: Member name
defs.desc: Who we are servicing.

defs.label: How long has the member waited?
defs.desc: Delay-in-response is a top bucket in the historic log; this field is what the breach is judged on.

defs.label: Public platform involved?
defs.desc: Anything on Google or Instagram routes a copy to Marketing before we reply, whatever the SLA says.

defs.label: Channel the member used
defs.desc: Where the service broke; also tells us whether the channel is even monitored.

defs.label: Staff contacted (names + dates)
defs.desc: The chases so far, so the escalation arrives with evidence.
defs.condText: Yes — if response_waited is 1 day or more

defs.label: Member ID (Momence)
defs.desc: For account lookups.

defs.label: Membership / package held
defs.condText: Yes — if retention or credit is involved

defs.label: Reply committed to member by
defs.desc: The commitment made to the member, tracked separately from the internal SLA.
defs.condText: Yes — if a time was promised

defs.label: Asset / post link
defs.desc: Drive / Figma / live post URL.
defs.condText: Yes — if a live or drafted asset exists

defs.label: Brand topic
defs.desc: Groups everything a marketing lead needs to triage in one pass.

defs.label: Commercial terms
defs.desc: Commercial mode decides the Accounts hand-off and the TDS / GST treatment.
defs.condText: Yes — if barter or paid collab

defs.label: Deliverables and counts
defs.desc: What each side owes, with dates - the field that stops 'that was not in it'.
defs.condText: Yes — if a collab is agreed

defs.label: Go-live / deadline date
defs.desc: The date the approval chain must clear.
defs.condText: Yes — if anything is scheduled

defs.label: Partner / brand / creator
defs.desc: Legal entity name for the agreement.
defs.condText: Yes — if collaboration or ambassador

defs.label: Who may speak publicly
defs.desc: Prevents a studio answering a journalist on the wrong note.
defs.condText: Yes — if press or PR enquiry

defs.label: Program / campaign name
defs.condText: Yes — if collab, ambassador, Barreter or campaign

defs.label: Member likeness usage
defs.desc: Consent gate. If 'no consent on file', the asset cannot go live at any SLA.
defs.condText: Yes — if a member, testimonial or in-studio shoot is involved

defs.label: Program status
defs.desc: Keeps the ambassador pipeline in one place rather than in DMs.
defs.condText: Yes — if Barreter or ambassador program

defs.label: Platform
defs.desc: Where it ran or will run.
defs.condText: Yes — if the asset is social

defs.label: Contracted value (INR)
defs.desc: Needed by Accounts before anything goes live.
defs.condText: Yes — if Paid or Revenue share

defs.label: CCTV footage preserved?
defs.desc: Footage rolls over on a fixed cycle; if it is not preserved now it is gone. Hard gate on this workflow.
defs.condText: Yes — if theft, harassment or injury

defs.label: CCTV timestamp to pull
defs.desc: To the minute, plus 15 minutes either side.
defs.condText: Yes — if cctv_retention needs pulling

defs.label: Mandatory welfare follow-up due
defs.desc: Welfare call or check-in, tracked as its own SLA item so it is never skipped.
defs.condText: Yes — if injury or harassment

defs.label: Exact location
defs.desc: Room-level precision for CCTV retrieval.

defs.label: Incident type
defs.desc: Sets which second department is auto-added to the thread.

defs.label: Injury?
defs.desc: Any injury forces critical and opens the insurance note at the same time.

defs.label: Medical response given
defs.desc: Time, who attended, first-aid items used, ambulance called at what time. This becomes the legal record.
defs.condText: Yes — if injury_occurred is not 'No'

defs.label: Member / family informed?
defs.desc: Owner-level comms; the desk must not improvise here.
defs.condText: Yes — if injury occurred

defs.label: Police / legal escalation
defs.desc: Determines who may speak about this ticket at all.

defs.label: Witnesses
defs.desc: Names and role of everyone present, staff and members.
defs.condText: Yes — if injury, theft or harassment

defs.label: Regulatory / association note
defs.desc: Whether this has to be reported outside the business, and by when.
defs.condText: Yes — if fire, structural or licensing issue

defs.label: CCTV requested / reviewed?
defs.desc: Must happen before the overwrite window; this is the time-critical step.
defs.condText: Yes — if 'Stolen' is suspected

defs.label: Lost and found checked?
defs.desc: Log requirement before a lost item can be treated as theft.
defs.condText: Yes — if 'Lost by member' or 'Misplaced'

defs.label: Compensation sought
defs.desc: Keeps the ask explicit so the desk is not negotiating blind.

defs.label: Item category
defs.desc: Groups like-for-like and sets the valuation route.

defs.label: Item description
defs.desc: Make, model, colour, any distinguishing mark.

defs.label: Declared value (INR)
defs.desc: Feeds the compensation decision and any insurance claim.
defs.condText: Yes — if 'Stolen' or 'Damaged in our custody'

defs.label: Last seen - time and place
defs.desc: Narrative anchor for CCTV and for the room search log.

defs.label: Locker number
defs.desc: Which locker, and whether the lock was forced or opened with a staff key.
defs.condText: Yes — if locker related

defs.label: Item status
defs.desc: Diverges the workflow at the first field: 'stolen' opens CCTV and an incident, 'lost' opens lost and found.

defs.label: Police complaint
defs.desc: Escalation state; owner sign-off precedes any FIR.
defs.condText: Yes — if theft is suspected

defs.label: Member ID (Momence)
defs.desc: Links the claim to the account for compensation.
defs.condText: Yes — if a member is involved

defs.label: Serial / IMEI number
defs.desc: Needed for a police complaint on a phone or laptop.
defs.condText: Yes — if electronics are involved

defs.label: What kind of issue
defs.desc: A catch-all needs a sorter, otherwise nothing is reportable.

defs.label: Noise / disturbance source
defs.desc: Only the source decides whether this is our fix or a complaint to a third party.
defs.condText: Yes — if misc_bucket is Noise or construction

defs.label: Time of day it occurs
defs.desc: The recurrence pattern decides whether we need a walkthrough or a meter.
defs.condText: Yes — if environmental (noise, temperature, light, odour)

defs.label: Room most affected
defs.desc: Narrower than 'area' - where it is worst, not just where it was noticed.
defs.condText: Yes — if environmental

defs.label: Suggestion for whom?
defs.desc: Direct routing for ideas, so they reach a decision-maker rather than a bin.
defs.condText: Yes — if misc_bucket = Suggestion / idea

defs.label: Suggested action
defs.desc: The reporter's own fix idea; retained even when declined, for the quarterly review.

defs.label: Studios this applies to
defs.desc: A policy issued for Mumbai only is a different document from a network-wide one.

defs.label: Source of truth for the data
defs.desc: Named deliberately: the historic log records 'Momence does not give accurate data', so if the source is disputed the report is too.
defs.condText: Yes — if report_spec is filled

defs.label: Decision required from
defs.desc: Names the human who must say yes, so the memo does not sit unread in a thread.
defs.condText: Yes — if internal_type is Approval needed or Policy change

defs.label: Needed by
defs.desc: Internal asks with no deadline inherit the SLA and die quietly; this one carries a real date.

defs.label: Follow-up due
defs.desc: Date the follow-up must happen by; audited at the weekly ops review.
defs.condText: Yes — if followup_owner is set

defs.label: Follow-up owner
defs.desc: A named person who owes the next touch, not a team.
defs.condText: Yes — if lead_ref or report_spec is filled

defs.label: Internal request type
defs.desc: What kind of internal work item this is; decides whether it is a task, a decision or a policy change.

defs.label: Lead / prospect reference
defs.desc: Lead name, source event and contact detail, so follow-up survives the person who captured it leaving.
